title: Rock Paper Scissors
description: Play the classic Rock Paper Scissors game against the computer.
about:
Rock Paper Scissors is a browser game where you choose rock, paper or scissors and compare your choice with the computer. Keep playing to improve your score.

Start a round in your browser and use the controls below to play.
howToPlay: Choose rock, paper or scissors and compare your choice with the computer. Keep playing to improve your score.
tips: Use click / tap to choose rock, paper or scissors.
Try another round to practice the timing and strategy.

faq.question: How do I play Rock Paper Scissors?
faq.answer: Choose rock, paper or scissors and compare your choice with the computer. Keep playing to improve your score.

faq.question: Can I play Rock Paper Scissors in a browser?
faq.answer: Yes. Open the game page and play without installing an app.
